response.content: {"critique": "I checked the problem of manually configuring permissions per user with no way to copy role settings, against the five similar items. The closest, Shortcut 4138 'Organisation settings' (unstarted) and 4131 'Workspace administration' (completed 2026-09-15), only cover general settings/permission management dashboards and do not mention copying roles or templates for new users. The Notion 'Account settings' page (Planned) covers personal preferences and security, not role assignment duplication, and the remaining stories (payment history, activity timeline) are unrelated. All similarity scores are very low (max 0.055), and no shipped story or roadmap item solves this specific problem.", "verdict": "pass"}
